name: Regular octahedron
description: The regular octahedron is a platonic solid with 8 equilateral triangle faces. It can be constructed by taking the dual of a cube, rectifying a tetrahedron or attaching a square pyramid to itself

sections.Properties:
Convex
Isogonal
Isohedral
Isotoxal
Deltahedron
Composite

trivia: The regular octahedron is commonly used as a D8 in tabletop games
